examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The dark chip beside the primary action of a docs home: the label, then the marks of the agents the prompt works with. It stays dark in both themes, so it reads as the AI entry point next to `Get started`.

examples.name: Agents
examples.summary: A custom agent list, and the label alone with `:agents="[]"`. The marks are single-colour and decorative; their names reach screen readers as the description.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled`: the chip greys out and copies nothing.
